children.text: What is play? What does play do for us?

From childhood make-believe and theatre to sports and market speculation, play takes many forms for humans: it offers entertainment and leisure while giving people a way to explore the world and its possibilities through imagined or constructed settings. Play serves as a fundamental mechanism for human learning, cultural expression, and social-bond formulating across our lifespans. Play can involve many participants. We play with objects, with our thoughts, with fellow humans--strangers, friends, and loved-ones, and with other life forms.
